attributes.action: seek the dissolution of Parliament and hold an immediate general election
attributes.additional_details:
We believe immigration and border security have become matters of significant national importance. We believe many members of the public want the opportunity to vote on policies relating to legal immigration, illegal immigration, asylum, border security, and immigration enforcement.
We therefore ask the Government to seek a fresh democratic mandate through an immediate general election.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to seek the dissolution of Parliament and hold an immediate general election so that the British people can vote on the future direction of UK immigration policy.

rejection.details:
we already have a petition open calling for an immediate general election:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
